The total of the 'Did NOT catch Covid' column is $295$, and the other column totals $175$.

$$\begin{aligned} \text{Total surveyed} &= 295 + 175 \\ &= 470 \end{aligned}$$

Hence option C is correct.

There are $105$ females in the table, and $29$ of them joined the workforce.
$$P = \dfrac{29}{105}$$
So the answer is option B.
